decision_basis: Verified cost-inclusive dividend coverage and modest H1 operating-profit growth support utility ownership, but a RM169.6m buffer is narrow against large borrowings/leases and heavy grid investment.16.83x earnings, declining reported profit and weak technicals leave the direction balanced.
manager_assessment: Agree independently with the manager: covered income is real, but buffer scale and obligations do not establish clear directional compensation.
score_interpretation: Signed strength of the present evidence-supported thesis; not a win probability or historical edge.
